SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   C. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat The School as rumours only.
   C. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

4. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   B. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

11. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   B. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.

12. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   B. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   D. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
